scope: Authorized fixed Medium V4-to-V5 Design 1 continuation; no foundation training
method: Store Item64 SiLU hidden rows only; factor the linear K/V residual output into query-key scores and weighted values; apply the original Response256 after aggregation
state_scope: Per-user persistent tensor payload; shared weights/projections and transient candidate buffers reported separately
checks: Reference same-weight logits, nonzero bias/output scales, real append/evict equivalence, native cache unchanged, cost ledger, source binding and persistent-state accounting
runtime_basis: Previous Item64 fit103s for64epochs, Response256 fit41s for200epochs, single-policy evaluation82s slowest shard plus startup/aggregation; compact execution requires measured canary
gpu_placement: Canaries then independent calibration on available cards; four-shard evaluation only after calibration completes
